page.overview:
What is Skyraptors of Unavartan?

The Skyraptors of Unavartan were a group associated with Unavartan that was supposedly defeated singlehandedly by Enfys Nest, leader of the Cloud-Riders, during a running fight over the course of a single night. The Corellian Tivoche Bilure mentioned Nest's supposed defeath of the Skyraptors in a book that he wrote about his time bartending at the Lodge at Fort Ypso on the planet Vandor.

The Skyraptors of Unavartan were mentioned in the 2018 replica journal Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor, which was written by Jason Fry.

Solo: A Star Wars Story: Tales from Vandor
